sources.title: README.md · LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B-ONNX at main - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: ONNX export of LFM2.5-8B-A1B for cross-platform inference. LFM2.5-8B-A1B is a Mixture of Experts model with 8B total parameters and about 1B active parameters per token. It uses 32 experts with 4 experts activated per token, combining the efficiency of sparse models with the quality of larger dense models.

sources.title: LFM2.5-8B-A1B - Liquid Docs
sources.snippet: 8B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 1.5B active parameters for fast, reliable tool calling and 128K context ← Back to Text Models LFM2.5-8B-A1B is Liquid AI's Mixture-of-Experts model, combining 8B total parameters with only 1.5B active parameters per forward pass with a 128K context window and chain of thought reasoning.

sources.title: LFM2.5-8B-A1B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: Builds on the October 2025 LFM2-8B-A1B, expanding the context window to 128K and scaling pretraining from 12T to 38T tokens. Released May 28 2026 under the LFM Open License; caught in a July catalog-gap sweep. LFM2.5-8B-A1B is tracked as a open-weight model from Liquid AI. Released 2026-05-28.
